detaileddescription.para: Calls: lock(), begin(), end(), updateStats(), erase().
Implements distributed speculative decoding following the DSD (Draft-Speculate-Verify) pattern for Converged Storage-Inference architectures:

listitem.para: Draft Phase: A lightweight draft model on one shard proposes token sequences
Speculate Phase: The proposing shard sends draft tokens to the target shard
Verify Phase: The target shard's larger model verifies the draft in a single pass

detaileddescription.para:
Key features:
Cross-shard draft generation and verification
Adaptive speculation based on acceptance rates
Latency-aware shard selection
Load-balanced draft distribution
Fallback to local/non-speculative decoding
This coordinator enables 2-3x speedup for inference workloads in distributed environments while maintaining exact output distributions.
